podcast.body: This album was Donna Summer's debut, with all songs produced and written by Giorgio Moroder and Pete Bellotte. It presented a pastiche of styles, showcasing the breadth of Summer's diverse pop influences, including an homage to 60s girl group pop. "All of the songs were produced and written by Moroder and Balotti. The album was a pastiche of styles, showcasing the breadth of Summer's pop influences."
